title: Vendor Lateness and the Home Delivery Charge — Ridgeline Special Order Services Paid-in-Full Programs
content:
A late vendor reduces the home delivery charge on a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order, through the lateness share.

**Clause.** The lateness share depends on the calendar days by which the ready date is later than the promised ready date: more than twice the program's vendor delay threshold gives a lateness share of 0.6; more than the threshold but not more than twice the threshold gives 0.8; otherwise the lateness share is 1.

The home delivery charge billed is multiplied by the lateness share before its single rounding to the nearest cent; the share itself is never rounded.

## Terms used

- **The ready date** is the date the item became ready at the store; **the promised ready date** is the date promised at order, which never moves.
- **The program's vendor delay threshold** is the figure of the order's program.

## Bands for the paid-in-full programs

| Program | Threshold (days) | Share 0.6 | Share 0.8 | Share 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 14 | more than 28 days late | 15 to 28 days late | 14 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 10 | more than 20 days late | 11 to 20 days late | 10 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 10 | more than 20 days late | 11 to 20 days late | 10 days late or less |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical Cut-to-Order Flooring order, promised ready date 1 June, charge of 79.00 before the share)

| Ready date | Days late | Share | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 June | 10 | 1 | 79.00 |
| 12 June | 11 | 0.8 | 63.20 |
| 21 June | 20 | 0.8 | 63.20 |
| 22 June | 21 | 0.6 | 47.40 |
| 30 May | 0 (ready early) | 1 | 79.00 |
